summary: Rainmaker Worldwide filed a late 8-K disclosing mutual termination, effective April 30, 2026, of two longstanding consulting agreements with Larchwood Management Partners and 2752128 Ontario Ltd, as part of a restructuring of management arrangements and costs. The company acknowledged accrued obligations of about US$249k plus C$26k to Larchwood and US$260k plus C$7k to 2752128, mostly unpaid fees, expenses and convertible notes, now accruing 10% interest from May 1, 2026. The same filing supplements the April 22, 2026 resignation of director James Ross and related management/compensatory matters. Watch cash runway, note conversion overhang and any further board turnover.
